guide.summary: Old Town churches, museums, the zoo and lake boats, with breakfast cafés, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan around Mondays, when the Swiss National Museum, Kunsthaus Zürich, FIFA Museum and Museum für Gestaltung are all closed, and note that the Grossmünster church is closed on Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Swiss National Museum, Kunsthaus Zürich, FIFA Museum and Museum für Gestaltung close on Mondays. The Grossmünster closes on Tuesdays, and since 3 August 2026 its Karlsturm tower opens only Friday to Sunday.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.value: Book Lindt ahead; buy on site elsewhere
toolkit.copy: Lindt Home of Chocolate asks you to book your ticket online in advance and can sell out on the day. The Fraumünster (CHF 5) and Museum für Gestaltung sell tickets only on site.

toolkit.label: Walk-in bars
toolkit.copy: Widder Bar and Old Crow both state they take no reservations. At Kronenhalle, reservations are for the restaurant only, not the bar.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: At the Fraumünster, private photos without flash or tripod are allowed outside services, but the Chagall windows are copyright protected. The audio tour needs headphones and devices are not given to children under 6.

guide.dek: Start early at the Old Town churches, which open to visitors at 12 on Sundays, and save museum days for Tuesday to Sunday.
intro: Zurich's Old Town centres on two churches facing each other across the Limmat. The Grossmünster on Zwingliplatz opens Monday to Saturday from 10, with Sunday visiting from 12 after the morning service, and it is closed on Tuesdays. From 1 November winter hours run to 17:00. Its Karlsturm tower costs CHF 5 for adults and, since 3 August 2026, opens only Friday to Sunday. Across the river, the Fraumünster on Münsterhof charges CHF 5, sold on site only, and its entry includes a CHF 5 reduction on the Kunsthaus collection.

For museums, you should avoid Mondays. The Swiss National Museum beside the main station opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 17:00, with "Wars and us" running until 17 January 2027 and "Graphics: Designing the everyday" until 4 April 2027. Kunsthaus Zürich on Heimplatz stays open until 20:00 on Thursdays and shows "Maria Lassnig and Edvard Munch" until 21 February 2027. In Zurich West, the Museum für Gestaltung shows "Avant-Garde—Graphic Design on the Rise" until 21 February 2027, with free entry on Thursdays from 5pm, while Kunsthalle Zürich runs two shows until 10 January 2027.

With children, Zoo Zürich switches to winter hours from November, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., with the Masoala Rainforest opening at 10. Lindt Home of Chocolate in Kilchberg opens daily from 10 am to 7 pm but asks you to book online in advance, as same-day slots can sell out. The FIFA Museum on Seestrasse opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00. For a short ride, the Polybahn runs every five minutes from Central up to the ETH terrace, with fares included in ZVV zone 110.

For food, Café Henrici on Niederdorfstrasse opens at 8 every day and adds brunch at weekends. Haus Hiltl on Sihlstrasse runs its vegetarian buffet until 30 minutes before closing, and Les Halles serves moules et frites year-round. Kronenhalle takes online bookings for the restaurant only. In the evening, Widder Bar and Old Crow take no reservations, and Jules Verne Panoramabar on Uraniastrasse is closed Sundays and Mondays. Frau Gerolds Garten is in its winter season until 5 March 2027.
summaryCards: Pair the Grossmünster and Fraumünster in the morning with the Swiss National Museum, avoiding Tuesdays at the Grossmünster and Mondays at the museum.
Start with breakfast at Café Henrici from 8, then ride the Polybahn up to the ETH terrace.
Book Lindt Home of Chocolate online ahead, and plan walk-in time for Widder Bar and Old Crow, which take no reservations.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Babu's Bakery, Vicafe, Max Chocolatier and MAME returned HTTP 429 errors; Kafi Schoffel had a certificate error; Bauschänzli, Rheinfelder Bierhalle, Café Schober and St. Jakob Beck domains did not resolve; Museum Rietberg and Uto Kulm pages were readable but lacked hours or operating evidence, so all of these were left out. Published only partially: Sprüngli (Paradeplatz) and The Dolder Grand did not show hours on the pages read, ZSG lake boats showed a timetable PDF but no hours on the page, the Botanical Garden showed no November-March hours, and Kronenhalle, Zeughauskeller, Haus Hiltl, Swiss Chuchi and Old Crow showed hours and booking details but no dated 2026 content. The Kronenhalle homepage also contained an unrelated promotional paragraph linking to a medication site, which may indicate the page has been tampered with.
